title: Genomic correlates of self-reported psychic experiences: An exploratory analysis
citation: Wahbeh H, Delorme A, Cannard C, Rossner R, Yount G, Radin D. EXPLORE 2026; 22(4):103416.
design: N = 102 adults with direct-to-consumer microarray files; Random Forest classifier (median split of PsiSum), permutation importance with 200,000 permutations, FDR < 0.05.
effect_size_meaning: Unsigned standardized permutation importance (observed importance vs the permutation null mean and SD). It is not a beta or odds ratio and has no allele direction.
fdr_note: The paper gives FDR-corrected p = 0.026 for all listed RSIDs except rs10410488 (0.000001).
genes_note: Gene annotations exist only for the top 20 (main-text Table 3).
open_issues: No risk allele or per-group genotype frequencies were published.
Genotype encoding, genome build and strand convention were not stated.
The paper reports 52 low + 52 high for N = 102.
No code, data or trained model was released.
contact: Corresponding author: Helane Wahbeh (address printed in the paper).
